name: x2611_16338_initial_subset
statement: (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsRegularOfDegree 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s = Fintype.card V / 2 + 1) (hs3 : 3 ≤ s) : ∃ U : Finset V, U.card = Fintype.card V / 2 ∧ Fintype.card V / 2 - 1 ≤ (G.induce (↑U : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard ∧ s - 2 ≤ (G.induce (↑U : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard
closed: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsRegularOfDegree 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s = Fintype.card V / 2 + 1) (hs3 : 3 ≤ s), ∃ U : Finset V, U.card = Fintype.card V / 2 ∧ Fintype.card V / 2 - 1 ≤ (G.induce (↑U : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard ∧ s - 2 ≤ (G.induce (↑U : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard
informal: Section 3: initial subset size and edge lower bound
original:
We choose the initial subset $U\subset V(G)$ as follows.
Let $G_{1},G_{2},\ldots,G_{\ell}$ be the connected components of $G$ , and write $n_{i}=|V(G_{i})|$ .
Let $k\geq 0$ denote the largest integer such that

 $\rho:=\sum_{i=1}^{k}n_{i}<n/2,$ 

where an empty sum is zero.
Note that $n_{k+1}\geq n/2-\rho$ .
Let $T$ be a spanning tree of $G_{k+1}$ , and pick any subtree $S$ of $T$ having $n/2-\rho$ vertices.
Let

 $U=V(G_{1})\cup\cdots\cup V(G_{k})\cup V(S).$ 

We have $|U|=n/2$ .
Moreover, since each $G_{i}$ is cubic and $S$ is a tree, we have

 $a\geq\sum_{i=1}^{k}|E(G_{i})|+|E(S)|=\frac{3\rho}{2}+\left(\frac{n}{2}-\rho-1\right)\geq\frac{n}{2}-1=s-2,$ 

as desired.
type: ∀ (V : Type u_1) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.IsRegularOfDegree 3 → ∀ (s : ℕ), s = Fintype.card V / 2 + 1 → 3 ≤ s → ∃ U, U.card = Fintype.card V / 2 ∧ Fintype.card V / 2 - 1 ≤ (SimpleGraph.induce (↑U) G).edgeSet.ncard ∧ s - 2 ≤ (SimpleGraph.induce (↑U) G).edgeSet.ncard
